messages:
maya: :wave: Heads up — Handbook v2.5 is going live this Friday. Main updates: parental leave matrix (global), new accessibility & accommodations section, and a short micro-training for policy refresh. Managers: please confirm team ack + any accommodation requests by Mon 04/11. Details + tracker here: https://go.re/redwood-handbook-v2-5

jon: Thanks Maya — is the accommodation request form public or internal?

maya: Internal. Use this form: https://go.re/rw-accom-request. We capture requests in the tracker; HR will redact names for audit exports on request. If someone prefers confidential routing, DM me or send to hr@redwood.example.com.

linda: Quick Q — do individual contributors need to take the new 20-min micro-training, or is it manager-only?

maya: All employees must complete the 20-min micro-training + short quiz (~5 questions). Managers additionally certify team review in the tracker (there's a checkbox column).

samir: Can we get a CSV export for our EU contractors so our LMS can ingest completion data?

maya: Yes — I'll run an export with PII redacted and place it in the secure S3 share. ETA Tue 04/12. Note: contractors will still get the same training link but completion will be tracked separately.

hr-bot: Reminder: training window opens 04/08 and closes 04/30. Late completions require manager approval.

jon: I'll collect any accommodation requests from my team and update the tracker by EOD Mon.

carl: Are we running office hours for managers who have questions about the new wording?

maya: Yes — office hours Thu 10:00am PT and Fri 4:00pm PT. Calendar invites sent to managers. Recording + FAQ will be posted to the handbook page after the sessions.

linda: About the ack — is it an e-sign or just a checkbox in the LMS?

maya: E-sign via DocuSign for the official ack. We'll send per-employee envelopes (no one-click mass e-sign). The tracker will mirror who has signed.

jon: Got it, thanks. :thumbsup:

maya: P.S. For compliance/audit: we'll snapshot the tracker and changelog after rollout. If you see any ambiguous policy wording, flag it here and I'll loop in Legal to get a fast clarification.
